prompts: A lean, wiry man in his early thirties with a gaunt, long face, prominent cheekbones, messy greasy short hair, and visible stubble sprints down a long abandoned office corridor. He wears a dark blue old jacket with a torn left cuff, a grey crew-neck T-shirt, black cargo pants covered in dust at the hems, and badly worn black sneakers. A fresh scratch marks the back of his right hand. The corridor is lined with closed grey fire doors, fluorescent lights flickering overhead. Handheld camera follows from behind at full-body wide shot, slightly low angle, cold high-contrast lighting, desaturated concrete and metal tones. He lunges toward a water bottle standing at the corridor's end, reaching out, but the bottle vanishes mid-grab; he crashes down onto his knees, right palm scraping the floor. Dust puffs up.

A lean, gaunt man with a long thin face, prominent cheekbones, messy greasy short hair and visible stubble, wearing a worn dark-blue jacket with a torn left cuff, a grey crew-neck T-shirt, black cargo pants dusted with dirt at the hems, and badly worn black sneakers, with a fresh scratch on the back of his right hand, creeps cautiously around the corner of an abandoned office corridor. The corridor is lined with closed grey fire doors, lit by flickering fluorescent tubes overhead that cast hard, cold, high-contrast light and metallic shadows. Shot in medium shot from a fixed low angle, landscape 832x480. He slowly leans his upper body into frame from the right edge, lowers his stance, and takes one deliberate silent step forward while reaching his right hand tentatively toward a small plastic water bottle on the floor. Just before his fingertips touch it, the bottle vanishes with a faint ripple, and he freezes.

Close-up, side angle, fixed camera on a man in a derelict office corridor: thin long face, prominent cheekbones, messy greasy short hair, visible stubble, lean build, dark blue worn jacket with a torn left cuff over a gray crew-neck T-shirt, black cargo pants dusty at the hem, badly worn black sneakers, a fresh scratch on the back of his right hand. Fluorescent lights flicker over gray fire doors. In cold high-contrast light he swings his fist into the wall; plaster cracks and falls away to reveal a red fire hydrant. He grabs the extinguisher, slams it into the glass; the glass bursts and a hard jet of water erupts, drenching the corridor. The camera shakes slightly with each impact.

A 30-35 year old man, thin long face, prominent cheekbones, messy greasy short hair, visible stubble, lean build, wearing a dark blue old jacket with a torn left cuff, grey crew-neck T-shirt, black cargo pants dusty at the ankles, worn black sneakers, a fresh scratch on the back of his right hand. He kneels on a flooded floor in a narrow abandoned office corridor, grey fire doors on both sides, a flickering fluorescent light overhead. A fire hydrant on the wall blasts a thick jet of water. Wide shot, slightly low angle, camera slowly trucks right from the hydrant nozzle toward the kneeling man. He gulps water desperately, cupping it with both hands, but it slips through his fingers. The water level drops rapidly, swirling around his knees. Cold blue-grey palette, high contrast, metallic and concrete textures.

A medium shot, camera fixed behind a kneeling man, looking down a long abandoned office corridor. The man, Chen Mo, has a lean long face with prominent cheekbones, messy greasy short hair, visible stubble, a thin wiry build, wearing a dark blue old jacket with a torn left cuff, a grey crew-neck T-shirt, black cargo pants with dusty hems, and badly worn black sneakers; a fresh scratch on the back of his right hand. He kneels on wet concrete, water fully receded, and slowly lifts his head. At the far end of the corridor, a single new water bottle stands under a flickering fluorescent tube. He gives a bitter, resigned smile, shoulders slumping, and does not stand up. Cold high-contrast lighting, grey fire doors on both sides, metal and concrete textures. Landscape 832x480.
